title: EastWest 9-month profit falls 24% to P5B

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — East West Banking Corp.’s net income fell by 24.2 percent to P5 billion in the first nine months of 2026 from P6.6 billion a year earlier, as heightened credit risks weighed on otherwise stronger operations. On Friday, the Gotianun family-led bank said it booked P15.9 billion in provisions for expected credit losses, citing a more difficult and uncertain economic environment. Its non-performing loan coverage stood at 90 percent. READ: EastWest first half profit drops 17% to P3.4B Earnings declined despite double-digit revenue growth and improved operating efficiency.
